formulas.description: 1-yr Renewal uses Season directly; every other term (2/3-yr Renewal, 2/3-yr New Business) uses the Contract Season Start year collected on this screen.
formulas.name: frmBeginningSeasonMembership

formulas.description: Builds the read-only Escalator text shown to the user based on Term Length. 2-yr and 3-yr Renewal keep the existing escalator language. 2-yr and 3-yr New Business use a 3% escalator starting in 2028 (and also in 2029 for the 3-yr term). 1-yr Renewal has no escalator.
formulas.name: frmEscalatorText
formulas.expression: IF( {!termLength} = {!TermLength_2YearRenewal}, "2 yr agreement escalator is 2.5%", IF( {!termLength} = {!TermLength_3YearRenewal}, "3 yr agreement (escalator in yr 2 is 1%, escalator in yr 3 is 2%)", IF( {!termLength} = {!TermLength_2YearNewBusiness}, "2 yr New Business agreement - 3% escalator starting 2028", IF( {!termLength} = {!TermLength_3YearNewBusiness}, "3 yr New Business agreement - 3% escalator in both 2028 and 2029", "No escalator applies for a 1 yr agreement" ) ) ) )

formulas.description: Resolves the Entity Name to save on the Opportunity from the Flex Agreement screen: the newly typed value if the user chose to overwrite; otherwise, if Leave As Is was chosen, the related Account's Name (used for both Person Accounts and standard Accounts, based on Account.IsPersonAccount).

formulas.description: Resolves the Entity Name to save on the Opportunity from the Membership Terms screen: the newly typed value if the user chose to overwrite; otherwise, if Leave As Is was chosen, the related Account's Name (used for both Person Accounts and standard Accounts, based on Account.IsPersonAccount).
formulas.name: frmFinalEntityName_Membership

formulas.description: Resolves the Entity Name to save on the Opportunity from the Multi Product Agreement screen: the newly typed value if the user chose to overwrite; otherwise, if Leave As Is was chosen, the related Account's Name (used for both Person Accounts and standard Accounts, based on Account.IsPersonAccount).
formulas.name: frmFinalEntityName_MultiProduct

formulas.name: frmFinalEntityName_SuiteLease

formulas.description: The larger of the ticket-row count and the parking-row count - drives how many times Row_Entry loops.
formulas.name: frmMaxRows

formulas.description: Resolves the Number of Games (Parking) value for the current row: the typed number when "Others" is picked, otherwise the numeric value of the selected picklist choice (81/41/40/20/10).
formulas.name: frmNumberOfGamesParkingFinal

formulas.description: Resolves the Number of Games (Seat) value for the current row: the typed number when "Others" is picked, otherwise the numeric value of the selected picklist choice (81/41/40/20/10).
formulas.name: frmNumberOfGamesSeatFinal

formulas.description: Total price divided by the selected Payment Plan term. Falls back to the full total when no Payment Plan is selected. ASSUMPTION: Membership_Agreement__c.Payment_Plan__c values are "5" and "12" - verify against the actual picklist and adjust the two TEXT() comparisons below if different.
formulas.name: frmProratedPayments

formulas.description: Row total = (Qty Seats x Price Seats) + (Qty Parking x Price Parking) for the record currently being visited by the Sum_Total_Price loop.
formulas.name: frmRowTotal

formulas.description: Combines the Membership screen's Season / Season Start Year / Season End Year inputs into the single text value stored on Opportunity.Season_Year__c. 1-yr Renewal only collects Season, so it is used as-is. Every other term (2/3-yr Renewal, 2/3-yr New Business) collects a start/end year instead, so those are joined with a dash (e.g. "2025-2027").
formulas.name: frmSeasonYearText

formulas.description: Counts how many seats the Row_Seat entry represents. Handles a single seat number (count = 1), a comma-separated list like 1,6 (count = number of comma-separated values), or a range like 111-112 or 111 - 112 (count = end - start + 1). Returns -1 when frmSeatFormatValid is false so the validation rule always fails on bad format. TRIM() protects against stray spaces around the dash, comma, or numbers.
formulas.name: frmSeatCountEntered
formulas.expression: IF( ISBLANK({!Row_Seat}), 0, IF( NOT({!frmSeatFormatValid}), -1, IF( CONTAINS({!Row_Seat}, ","), LEN({!Row_Seat}) - LEN(SUBSTITUTE({!Row_Seat}, ",", "")) + 1, IF( CONTAINS({!Row_Seat}, "-"), VALUE(TRIM(MID({!Row_Seat}, FIND("-", {!Row_Seat}) + 1, LEN({!Row_Seat}) - FIND("-", {!Row_Seat})))) - VALUE(TRIM(LEFT({!Row_Seat}, FIND("-", {!Row_Seat}) - 1))) + 1, 1 ) ) ) )

formulas.description: Validates the Row_Seat format is one of: a single seat number (8), a dash range (8-9), or a comma-separated list (1,6,9). Rejects anything else (letters, double commas, mixed comma+dash, trailing separators, etc).
formulas.name: frmSeatFormatValid

formulas.description: Calculated, read-only Starting Season for the Flex Agreement screen. Starting_Season_Flex__c = Beginning Season + 1.
formulas.name: frmStartingSeason_Flex

formulas.description: Calculated, read-only Starting Season for the Membership Terms screen. 1-yr Renewal: Season + Term Length (1). Every other term (2/3-yr Renewal, 2/3-yr New Business): Contract Season End + 1.
formulas.name: frmStartingSeason_Membership

formulas.description: Calculated, read-only Starting Season for the Multi Product Agreement screen. Starting_Season_Multi_Product__c = Season + 1.
formulas.name: frmStartingSeason_MultiProduct

formulas.description: Cents portion of This Season Total Amount, 0-99.
formulas.name: frmSuiteAmountCents

formulas.description: Comma-grouped currency text, e.g. $33,120.00. Built from the three digit groups because TEXT() on a number does not insert separators.
formulas.name: frmSuiteAmountFormatted
formulas.expression: "$" & IF( {!frmSuiteGroupMillions} > 0, TEXT({!frmSuiteGroupMillions}) & "," & RIGHT("00" & TEXT({!frmSuiteGroupThousands}), 3) & "," & RIGHT("00" & TEXT({!frmSuiteGroupUnits}), 3), IF( {!frmSuiteGroupThousands} > 0, TEXT({!frmSuiteGroupThousands}) & "," & RIGHT("00" & TEXT({!frmSuiteGroupUnits}), 3), TEXT({!frmSuiteGroupUnits}) ) ) & "." & RIGHT("0" & TEXT({!frmSuiteAmountCents}), 2)

formulas.description: Whole-dollar portion of This Season Total Amount.
formulas.name: frmSuiteAmountInt

formulas.description: Full legal amount text stored in Opportunity.This_Season_Total_Amount_in_Words__c, e.g. Thirty-Three Thousand One Hundred Twenty Dollars ($33,120.00). Supports amounts up to $999,999,999.99.
formulas.name: frmSuiteAmountInWords
formulas.expression: IF( BLANKVALUE({!This_Season_Total_Amount}, 0) = 0, "Zero Dollars ($0.00)", TRIM( IF({!frmSuiteGroupMillions} > 0, {!frmSuiteWordsMillions} & " Million ", "") & IF({!frmSuiteGroupThousands} > 0, {!frmSuiteWordsThousands} & " Thousand ", "") & {!frmSuiteWordsUnits} ) & " Dollars" & IF({!frmSuiteAmountCents} > 0, " and " & RIGHT("0" & TEXT({!frmSuiteAmountCents}), 2) & "/100", "") & " (" & {!frmSuiteAmountFormatted} & ")" )

formulas.description: Today plus 3 business days. MOD(date - 07-Jan-1900, 7) returns 0=Sunday through 6=Saturday, so Wed/Thu/Fri roll forward 5 calendar days and Saturday rolls forward 4. Weekends only - company holidays are not excluded.
formulas.name: frmSuiteDueDate

formulas.description: Numeric value of the Total # of Games selection, stamped on Opportunity.Total_of_Games__c.
formulas.name: frmSuiteGamesFinal

formulas.description: Total # of Games spelled out in words followed by the number in brackets, e.g. Forty-One (41). Stamped on Opportunity.Total_of_Games_in_Words__c. Supports 1-99; blank when nothing is selected.
formulas.name: frmSuiteGamesInWords
formulas.expression: IF( {!frmSuiteGamesFinal} <= 0, "", IF( {!frmSuiteGamesFinal} < 20, CASE({!frmSuiteGamesFinal}, 1,"One", 2,"Two", 3,"Three", 4,"Four", 5,"Five", 6,"Six", 7,"Seven", 8,"Eight", 9,"Nine", 10,"Ten", 11,"Eleven", 12,"Twelve", 13,"Thirteen", 14,"Fourteen", 15,"Fifteen", 16,"Sixteen", 17,"Seventeen", 18,"Eighteen", 19,"Nineteen", ""), CASE(FLOOR({!frmSuiteGamesFinal} / 10), 2,"Twenty", 3,"Thirty", 4,"Forty", 5,"Fifty", 6,"Sixty", 7,"Seventy", 8,"Eighty", 9,"Ninety", "") & IF(MOD({!frmSuiteGamesFinal}, 10) > 0, "-" & CASE(MOD({!frmSuiteGamesFinal}, 10), 1,"One", 2,"Two", 3,"Three", 4,"Four", 5,"Five", 6,"Six", 7,"Seven", 8,"Eight", 9,"Nine", ""), "") ) & " (" & TEXT({!frmSuiteGamesFinal}) & ")" )

formulas.description: Millions digit group (0-999) of the amount.

formulas.description: Thousands digit group (0-999) of the amount.
formulas.name: frmSuiteGroupThousands

formulas.description: Units digit group (0-999) of the amount.
formulas.name: frmSuiteGroupUnits
